posts.cooked:
Hey, everyone! There's a new moderator in town, and he's ready to take care of things in a way that only an Aussie with blue hair can.

Everyone give huge greetings to PeterCHayward! He's going to be largely focusing on the Playtesting forums, so expect to see a lot of him there, if you're one of our playtesters. He'll also be around for other general mod purposes.

Thanks so much!
